abstract: Maintains atmospheric monitoring records and toxic containment status
system_message:
You are the subterranean hazardous materials brigade (HVRB), responsible for maintaining atmospheric monitoring records, toxic containment status, and subterranean chemical suppression readiness.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Compressed air foam suppression logistics（FOAM）
information_points.content:
HVRB-FOAM-9OT：Under the Parallel service gallery electric shuttle evacuation scheme, the foam concentrate reserve volume stocked across subterranean intermediate emergency turnout niches is 12,000 L of total fluorosurfactant-free firefighting foam concentrate on site.
HVRB-FOAM-U2E：Under the Subterranean cavern shelter-in-place and airlock extraction scheme, the foam concentrate reserve volume within subterranean intermediate emergency turnout niches is 5,000 L of total fluorosurfactant-free firefighting foam concentrate on site.
HVRB-FOAM-N58：Under the Cross-bore pressurized portal evacuation scheme, the foam concentrate reserve volume held across subterranean intermediate emergency turnout niches is 8,000 L of total fluorosurfactant-free firefighting foam concentrate on site.

information_points.title: Maintains atmospheric monitoring records and toxic containment status（HAZMAT）
information_points.content:
HVRB-HAZMAT-TON：For the Parallel service gallery electric shuttle evacuation scheme, toxic gas monitoring is operational according to active real-time telemetry from carbon monoxide, nitric oxide, and hydrocarbon gas detectors across subsea roadway crowns.
HVRB-HAZMAT-I6R：For the Cross-bore pressurized portal evacuation scheme, toxic gas monitoring is operational based on continuous sensor strings across subsea roadway crowns logging active real-time telemetry from carbon monoxide, nitric oxide, and hydrocarbon gas detectors.
HVRB-HAZMAT-CII：For the Subterranean cavern shelter-in-place and airlock extraction scheme, toxic gas monitoring is not operational across the continuous sensor strings along subsea roadway crowns.
